notes.title: Altered Algorithm is live!
notes.notes:
🚀 Exciting News: Altered Algorithm is now LIVE and FREE on Steam! 🎮

We are thrilled to announce that Altered Algorithm, our anticipated test game, is now available on Steam for VR. This is a small "Early Access" experience to test the FMV approach in VR. We would love your feedback.

Altered Algorithm is not just another game; it's an immersive experience that blends FMV and games into one.

🎮 Key Features:

Engaging Storyline: Immerse yourself in a narrative that unfolds as you progress through the game.
Puzzles: Test your wits with a variety of puzzles that will push your problem-solving skills...
Dynamic Gameplay: Adapt and evolve as you encounter new challenges and obstacles at every turn.

Whether you're a seasoned gamer looking for your next challenge or a casual player seeking an unforgettable gaming experience, Altered Algorithm has something for everyone.

So, what are you waiting for? Download Altered Algorithm now and embark on an epic adventure.

Note: Altered Algorithm requires a compatible PC to play. Check the Steam page for system requirements.
